name: Download then execute from staging dir
description: curl or wget runs, then a binary from /tmp or /dev/shm starts on the same host within 10 minutes.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [process where executable like ("*/curl","*/wget") and command : "*http*"] [process where executable startswith "/tmp/" or executable startswith "/dev/shm/"]

name: Download, chmod +x, execute
description: Fetch, mark executable, run from a staging path, in order on one host.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=15m [process where executable like ("*/curl","*/wget")] [process where executable endswith "/chmod" and command : "*+x*"] [process where executable startswith "/tmp/"]

name: Recon burst then SSH lateral move
description: Network or host discovery tools followed by an ssh client to a user@host target within 15 minutes.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=15m [process where executable like ("*/nmap","*/arp","*/netstat","*/ss")] [process where executable endswith "/ssh" and command : "*@*"]

name: Recon then outbound ssh auth success
description: Discovery tool, then a successful ssh authentication on the same host.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=20m [process where executable endswith "/nmap"] [auth where method == "ssh" and outcome == "success"]

name: Cron persistence write then crontab run
description: A cron path is written, then crontab is invoked on the host.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [file where path startswith "/etc/cron" or path startswith "/var/spool/cron/"] [process where executable endswith "/crontab"]

name: Systemd unit written then enabled
description: A unit file appears under /etc/systemd/system and systemctl enable follows.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [file where path startswith "/etc/systemd/system/" and operation != "delete"] [process where executable endswith "/systemctl" and command : "*enable*"]

name: authorized_keys write then ssh login
description: authorized_keys is modified and an ssh authentication succeeds soon after.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=30m [file where path endswith "/authorized_keys" and operation != "delete"] [auth where method == "ssh" and outcome == "success"]

name: ld.so.preload write then process start
description: /etc/ld.so.preload changes and a new process starts afterwards.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=5m [file where path == "/etc/ld.so.preload"] [process where uid == 0]

name: SSH failures then success
description: Three ssh failures followed by a success on the same host.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [auth where method == "ssh" and outcome == "failure"] [auth where method == "ssh" and outcome == "failure"] [auth where method == "ssh" and outcome == "failure"] [auth where method == "ssh" and outcome == "success"]

name: Three ssh failures with no success between
description: Uses until: a success between failures cancels the attempt.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [auth where outcome == "failure"] [auth where outcome == "failure"] [auth where outcome == "failure"] until [auth where outcome == "success"]

name: Shell with /dev/tcp then network event, same pid
description: A shell using /dev/tcp and a network event attributed to the same pid.
query: sequence by host, pid with maxspan=2m [process where executable in ("/bin/bash","/bin/sh","/usr/bin/bash") and command : "*/dev/tcp/*"] [network where true]

name: Python inline code then network, same pid
description: python -c run followed by an outbound connection of the same process.
query: sequence by host, pid with maxspan=5m [process where executable : "*python*" and command : "* -c *"] [network where true]

name: Encoded PowerShell then network
description: powershell with an encoded command and a network event from the same pid.
query: sequence by host, pid with maxspan=5m [process where executable : "*powershell*" and command : "*-enc*"] [network where true]

name: Shadow read then outbound network, same pid
description: A process touching /etc/shadow with network activity on the same pid.
query: sequence by host, pid with maxspan=10m [process where command : "*/etc/shadow*"] [network where true]

name: Paste-site DNS then staged execution
description: A lookup of a paste or transfer site then a binary runs from /tmp.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=5m [dns where query : ("*pastebin.com","*transfer.sh","*ngrok.io")] [process where executable startswith "/tmp/"]

name: Staged binary then unsigned module load
description: A process from /tmp starts and an unsigned module loads in the same pid.
query: sequence by host, pid with maxspan=2m [process where executable startswith "/tmp/"] [module where signed == false]

name: Run key set then PowerShell
description: A Run registry value is set and powershell starts on the host.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [registry where key : "*\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" and operation == "set"] [process where executable : "*powershell*"]

name: Four home-directory modifications in 30s
description: Rapid file modifications under /home, a coarse ransomware shape.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=30s [file where path startswith "/home/" and operation == "modify"] [file where path startswith "/home/" and operation == "modify"] [file where path startswith "/home/" and operation == "modify"] [file where path startswith "/home/" and operation == "modify"]

name: whoami, id, uname in two minutes
description: The classic post-exploitation discovery trio.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=2m [process where executable endswith "/whoami"] [process where executable endswith "/id"] [process where executable endswith "/uname"]

name: sudo success then useradd
description: Privilege use followed by account creation.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=5m [auth where method == "sudo" and outcome == "success"] [process where executable endswith "/useradd"]

name: insmod then kernel module load
description: A module loader runs and a kernel-level module is recorded.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=1m [process where executable like ("*/insmod","*/modprobe")] [module where kind in ("kext","driver")]

name: Base64 decode then staged execution
description: Decode a payload then run something from /tmp.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=2m [process where command : "*base64 -d*"] [process where executable startswith "/tmp/"]

name: chmod u+s then root process from /tmp
description: setuid bit set, then a root-owned process starts from /tmp.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=10m [process where executable endswith "/chmod" and command : "*u+s*"] [process where uid == 0 and executable startswith "/tmp/"]

name: Write to /tmp then execute from /tmp
description: A file is created under /tmp and a binary starts there within 5 minutes (not the same path necessarily).
query: sequence by host with maxspan=5m [file where path startswith "/tmp/" and operation == "create"] [process where executable startswith "/tmp/"]

name: Repeated lookups of a suspicious TLD
description: Four lookups ending .top within 2 minutes, a DGA-ish shape.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=2m [dns where query like "*.top"] [dns where query like "*.top"] [dns where query like "*.top"] [dns where query like "*.top"]

name: Kerberos failures then success
description: Repeated Kerberos failures, then a success on the host.
query: sequence by host with maxspan=15m [auth where method == "kerberos" and outcome == "failure"] [auth where method == "kerberos" and outcome == "failure"] [auth where method == "kerberos" and outcome == "success"]

name: Netcat then network, same pid
description: nc or ncat with an exec flag, then a network event from that process.
query: sequence by host, pid with maxspan=2m [process where executable like ("*/nc","*/ncat") and command : "* -e *"] [network where true]

name: Encoded PowerShell command
description: The canonical single-event form.
query: process where executable like "*powershell*" and command : "*-enc*"

name: Shell history cleared
description: History wiped or disabled on the command line.
query: process where command : ("*history -c*","*HISTFILE=/dev/null*","*unset HISTFILE*")

name: Log file deleted
description: A file under /var/log was deleted.
query: file where path startswith "/var/log/" and operation == "delete"

name: SSH tunnelling flags
description: ssh with -R, -L or -D forwarding.
query: process where executable endswith "/ssh" and command regex " -[RLD] ?[0-9]"

name: Privileged container start
description: docker run with --privileged.
query: process where executable endswith "/docker" and command contains "--privileged"

name: Execution from /dev/shm
description: A process image under /dev/shm.
query: process where executable startswith "/dev/shm/"

name: Cryptominer command line
description: stratum or xmrig in a command line.
query: process where command : ("*stratum+tcp*","*xmrig*") and not executable endswith "/grep"

name: Service registry key created
description: A new Services key in the registry feed.
query: registry where key : "*\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" and operation == "create"

name: Unsigned driver or kext loaded
description: Unsigned kernel-level module.
query: module where signed == false and kind in ("driver","kext")
